answer: An adversary running 33 aliases hence needs 14 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in thread, expire in knoll, and echo lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4337 identities would post 2797 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
